groups.activity: research all four Wukong blueprints, unless your clan already has them
groups.meta: 3-day research each, runs in parallel; Ghost-tier (x1) costs shown

rows.label: Neuroptics
rows.note: 1 Nitain, 1 Neural Sensors, 1,000 Nano Spores, 500 Polymer Bundle

conditions: Resource costs multiply by clan tier: Shadow x3, Storm x10, Mountain x30, Moon x100; a Ghost-tier clan is the cheapest place to research.
Research is skipped entirely if any clanmate already unlocked it; the blueprints then just sit in the lab for credits.
Blueprints bought from another clan's finished research stay yours after you leave, so borrowing a clan to shop is an option.
bonuses: Split the resource cost across clanmates before starting if nobody has researched him yet; even at Shadow tier that keeps each donation under 1,000 Plastids.

disclosures.title: Nitain is the real gate
disclosures.body: Research alone needs 11 Nitain and crafting needs 6 more, 17 total for a solo researcher. Nitain is untradeable, unaffected by boosters, and comes only from the Nightwave Cred store (5 for 15 Cred).

groups.meta: 35,000 cr main; part prices unverified, confirm in the lab

rows.label: component blueprints
rows.note: credits each; the wiki's research page was unclear on the exact price

conditions: Each player buys their own blueprints once the clan's research is complete.

groups.meta: 17 total needed if researching and crafting solo

rows.label: Nitain Extract
rows.alt: Reactor Sabotage caches, ~2% chance of 1 Nitain

conditions: Nitain is untradeable and unaffected by boosters; Nightwave is the only vendor source.
bonuses: Twitch drops of Nightwave Cred show up on DE livestreams; streamframe.fyi tracks them if you're a few Cred short.
